description: a strong woman lady of the wild forest with light brown hair in braids, a huge white wolf pelt worn as a hooded mantle with the white wolf's head over her head, leather armour embossed with golden animal motifs and fur trim, a golden eagle sitting on the back of her shoulder with its talons on the shoulder, brown trousers and fur-topped boots, no bow, nothing in the hands but the reins, sitting upright and relaxed in the middle of the saddle exactly like the rider of the reference, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the face, chest and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near leg showing and the far leg hidden behind the horse, the near thigh lying forward along the saddle and the lower leg hanging straight down from the knee to the foot, one normal slim leg, not tucked up, not slanting, both upper arms down along the body and both forearms reaching forward, the two hands close together in front of the body above the horse's neck holding the reins, the same size and place as the reference rider, the whole figure from the top of the wolf's head to the foot inside the image, nothing under the rider, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look only: the face, hair, headwear, clothes and colours; not the pose and not the bow

a finished rider of the game which the author accepted: copy how it sits in the middle of the saddle seen from the side, the near thigh forward along the saddle and the lower leg hanging straight down, one leg showing, and how both hands reach forward together to the reins; not its face, clothes, colours or what it carries
the pose of the figure: sitting sideways, the near thigh forward and the lower leg hanging straight down, only the near leg; not its hood or cloak
